articles.summary: Regions Bank is offering flood-relief financial assistance for consumers and businesses, while the Regions Foundation is supporting Red Cross response efforts. Regions Bank on Monday announced a series of disaster-recovery financial services designed to help people and businesses in Indiana following catastrophic flooding that started Aug. 11, 2026. Additionally, the Regions Foundation , a nonprofit funded primarily by Regions Bank, announced a commitment of $25,000 in grant funding to support American Red Cross disaster relief efforts. Regions Bank and the Regions Foundation Announce Flood-Recovery Response for Indiana Communities The financial services announced by Regions Bank are available in portions of Indianapolis, Noblesville, Fishers and additional communities served by the bank. articles.summary: As Kate Danella of Regions succeeds Chief Administrative Officer Dave Keenan, John Jordan will be elevated to serve as head of Consumer Banking, and Chief People Officer Angela Santone will join the CEO’s leadership team. Regions Financial Corp. on Tuesday announced Chief Administrative Officer Dave Keenan will retire at the end of 2026 following more than two decades of leadership at the company. Kate Danella , currently head of Consumer Banking, will succeed Keenan as Chief Administrative Officer. John Jordan will succeed Danella as head of Consumer Banking, while Chief People Officer Angela Santone will begin reporting directly to Regions Chairman, President, and CEO John Turner . Dave Keenan, left, will be succeeded as Regions Chief Administrative Officer by Kate Danella, pictured second from left. John Jordan, pictured third from left, will succeed Danella as head of Consumer Banking for Regions. Chief People Officer Angela Santone, right, will begin reporting directly to Regions
articles.title: Regions Financial Announces Upcoming Retirement of Dave Keenan and New Executive Leadership Appointments
